list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Guides are original writing for this entry.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then activities, then collectibles, and save the long grinds for last. Keep this tracker updated as you go so the final stretch is a short clean-up list, not a surprise.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.tip: Earn every other trophy first; the platinum unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end and the trophy unlocks when its final cutscene finishes. It is the first story trophy, so it cannot be skipped, but treat it as missable in the sense that you should finish the mission in one clean run rather than quitting halfway. If anything goes wrong, replay the mission from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.tip: Finish the opening mission; replay it from the pause menu if you quit early.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically once the last mission of the chapter is complete, so just follow the story markers and do not worry about side content yet. Use the early chapters to learn the map and the driving and shooting controls.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.tip: Complete all Chapter 1 missions; the trophy follows the final one.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one is unmissable as long as you keep playing the story, and it unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends. Between story beats, grab nearby collectibles so the late-game clean-up is shorter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.tip: Complete all Chapter 2 missions; grab nearby collectibles on the way.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the story opens up Vice City itself, so expect more driving between objectives and more stranger missions appearing on the map. Keep a save before big missions in case you want a clean replay for a mission-specific trophy.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.tip: Complete all Chapter 3 missions; keep a save before big missions.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so by the time it pops you should have most story trophies in hand. Before moving to the final mission, check the missables list: any mission-specific trophy you have not earned yet should be replayed now.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.tip: Complete all Chapter 4 missions, then check missables before the finale.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is a gold trophy because it closes the whole campaign, and it unlocks when the ending plays out. Make a manual save before starting it: after the credits you can keep playing in the open world, but a pre-finale save is the safest way back if you want to redo any story choice.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.tip: Save manually before the final mission, then finish it.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies unlock when that mission ends, so follow its objectives to the final beat and do not abandon it midway. If you fail or quit, replay Breakfast Run from the pause menu's mission replay and finish it cleanly.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.tip: Finish Breakfast Run in full; replay it from the pause menu if needed.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase and an execution phase, so see both through to the end. If the heist fails, the mission replay in the pause menu lets you run it again without restarting the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.tip: Complete The Cartel Heist from setup to getaway; replay on failure.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Finish it in one run and let the closing scene play; the trophy pops at the mission's end, not at any checkpoint. If you leave the mission early, replay Child's Play from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.tip: Finish Child's Play and let its closing scene play out.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. As with the other named-mission trophies, the unlock comes when the mission itself is complete, so do not stop after a mid-mission checkpoint. A failed attempt costs nothing but time: mission replay puts you straight back at the start.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.tip: Complete Headliners end to end; mission replay is your safety net.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. Expect a combat-heavy sequence with a vehicle escape, so stock up on armour and ammo before the mission marker. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at its end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.tip: Stock armour and ammo before VCIA Takedown, then finish it.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. This is a named-mission trophy, so the unlock is tied to finishing that mission, not to a side objective. Play it through to the final beat and, if you fail, replay it from the pause menu rather than reloading an old save.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.tip: Finish Operation Savage Glory; replay from the pause menu on failure.

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion in the in-game stats screen. Full completion in GTA games means finishing the story, the stranger strands, the collectible sets and the activity checklists the stats screen tracks. Do it last: nearly every other trophy feeds into it, so chasing it early wastes effort. Check the stats screen regularly to see which category is still short.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.tip: Chase this last; the in-game stats screen shows what is still missing.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's tracked trick moments: jumps, near misses, long airtime and clean landings while driving or riding. The count builds across the whole playthrough, so you will already be part of the way there after the story. For the remainder, find a stunt jump or a long straight, use a fast car or bike, and repeat clean jumps; PSN tracks the total to 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Stunts count across the whole game; grind the last ones at a stunt jump.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side pastimes, such as shooting-range challenges, drone races, regular races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and meditation, plus the remaining types the activity menu lists. Open the activities menu, work down the list, and do one session of each; you do not need to win or finish them all, just try them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.tip: Open the activities list and try one of each of the 9 types.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range and work through its challenge list weapon by weapon; PSN tracks the gold-medal count to 42. Learn each challenge's scoring first with a bronze run, then push for gold: steady aim and reloading between waves matter more than speed. Replaying a challenge is free, so grind the hardest ones last.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Gold all 42 range challenges; replay any challenge as often as needed.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own drone race; winning one marks that location off, and PSN tracks the count to 14. Fly the racing line rather than the shortest line, cut corners only where the gates allow, and use boost on the long straights. A loss costs nothing, so retry a location until you win it.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations; retry losses for free.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count once each, so you need 20 distinct race events won, not 20 wins of the same race. Work through the race list across cars, bikes and boats, and pick a vehicle you handle well for each type. A tuned car and clean racing lines beat raw speed on most courses.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Win 20 different races; repeats of one race do not count twice.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests scored on the catch, so pick good bait, cast where the fish are showing, and keep the line tension in the safe zone while reeling. If Cal beats you, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.tip: Beat Cal once in a fishing challenge; rechallenge him after a loss.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, start any game on it, and play it through to its end. You do not need a high score or a perfect run, just a completed game, so pick the shortest cabinet game you can find and finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.tip: Play any arcade cabinet game through to its end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands are chains of side missions for one character: follow Andy's marker each time it appears, finish every mission he gives you, and the trophy unlocks at the end of his last one. Do not leave a strand half-finished before the finale, in case later missions lock.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.tip: Finish every mission in Andy's strand, ending with his final one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's missions in order as his marker appears on the map; the strand ends with a final mission, and the trophy pops when it is done. If a mission fails, replay it from the pause menu and continue the chain.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.tip: Follow Kenton's strand to its final mission and complete it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger strand. Billy's missions are a chain, so keep answering his marker until the chain ends; the trophy is for the last mission, not for any single earlier one. Finish the strand before the story finale so nothing in it gets locked off.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.tip: Play Billy's strand through to its final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger strands are the side-mission chains marked for individual characters around the state, including Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Finish any 8 full chains; PSN tracks the count to 8. Explore the map between story missions so new stranger markers appear, and clear each chain as soon as it opens.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Complete any 8 full stranger strands; clear each chain as it opens.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger strand. Follow Randy's missions in order until his chain ends; the trophy unlocks at the end of that final mission. Keep the strand moving whenever his marker is up, rather than leaving it until after the finale.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.tip: Finish Randy's strand with its final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone's chain works like the other stranger strands: answer his marker, finish each mission in turn, and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. A failed mission can be replayed from the pause menu without losing the chain.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.tip: Play Tyrone's strand through to its final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points marked when you get close; sit, meditate, and the spot counts. Work through them region by region so you do not miss one: the map's explored-areas count helps confirm coverage. PSN tracks the total to 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Meditate at all 18 spots; clear them region by region.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at one special animal; follow his directions to its territory, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly. Bring a scoped rifle and approach from downwind so the animal does not bolt before you are in range.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.tip: Track Bret's unique animal quietly and take one clean shot.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in shops, houses and odd corners; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Search systematically, one district at a time, and check each set's progress in the collection menu so you know which cards are still missing. PSN tracks completed sets to 3.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Complete 3 full card sets; check the collection menu for missing cards.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world tagging interaction found at marked spots around Leonida; each new location you tag adds to the total, and PSN tracks it to 100. Tag every spot you pass while doing other things, and sweep the map district by district for the stragglers at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Tag every WAiNK spot you pass; sweep districts for the last ones.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small tracked feats across driving, shooting, flying and exploring, listed in the challenges menu. Most complete naturally during the story and activities; for the remainder, open the menu, pick the easiest unfinished ones first, and knock them out in batches. PSN tracks the total to 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Clear the easiest unfinished challenges first; most finish naturally.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it. Get the police to 4 stars by causing chaos while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears. Use tunnels, the countryside or a fast car to break the search; do not let your partner get arrested or killed, or the attempt ends.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.tip: Reach 4 stars with your partner, then hide until the heat clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. That means keeping the heat on the whole time: rob one shop, get straight to the next, and rob it before the wanted level drops. Plan a route of three close shops, keep a fast getaway car parked outside each one, and do not stop to fight the police between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Rob 3 nearby shops in one run while keeping your wanted level alive.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get in and drive it, so variety matters more than mileage. Drive everything you see: traffic cars, bikes, boats, trucks and the odd parked special. The vehicle list in the menu shows what you have found, and PSN tracks the total to 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Drive every new vehicle you see; check the vehicle list for gaps.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode; trigger it when at least 5 enemies are in front of you, such as during a gang shootout or a police chase, and drop them all before the meter runs out. Use a fast-firing weapon, aim for the head, and do not waste the meter on a single target.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Trigger Combat Focus facing 5+ enemies and drop them all in one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. Get onto the airfield, take a plane, and take off without following the usual departure routine: the trophy is about leaving the airport by air on your own terms. Expect a wanted level the moment you cross the tarmac, so be quick and already moving when the police respond.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.tip: Steal a plane at VCIA and take off unscheduled; expect police attention.

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos, the tanks, while the heat is on. Rhinos show up at high wanted levels, so push your wanted level up until one rolls in, then survive the encounter the way the trophy asks: stay mobile, use cover, and hit the tank where it counts. This one is a combat set-piece, so come with armour and heavy weapons.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.tip: Raise your wanted level until a Rhino tank appears, then handle it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quietly: avoid the cameras' cones, do not alert the staff, and get out with the goods before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so leave and try again rather than fighting your way out. A quiet approach and a fast exit are the whole trick.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.tip: Stay out of sight, grab the goods, leave before the alarm.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robbery targets: plan the entry, crack the vault, and get clear before the police lock the area down. Each successful vault-and-escape counts, and PSN tracks the total to 5. A fast car parked nearby and a planned escape route make every vault far easier.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time; park a fast getaway car.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; intercept one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the police. Blocking the truck with your own vehicle works better than chasing it, and a getaway car stashed nearby turns the escape into a formality.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.tip: Block an armored truck, crack it, then escape with a stashed car.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks each named area you have visited; driving, flying or sailing into a new area marks it. Work through the map region by region after the story, using a plane or helicopter for the far corners. PSN tracks the area count to 52.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Visit all 52 map areas; fly to the far corners to finish.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run sites marked around the map; hit one per gang and the set is complete. Expect armed resistance at each site, so bring weapons and armour, and escape cleanly after each robbery. PSN tracks the gang count to 9.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view, order a cocktail, and take in the view as the description asks. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge: any suitable beachfront spot where you can drink with the ocean in front of you should do it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.tip: Order a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a showroom, then power straight out through the glass front in the style the trophy's name hints at. Pick a showroom with a big glass frontage, build speed inside, and go through it; expect a wanted level and a repair bill afterwards.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.tip: Drive into a showroom, then smash out through the glass front.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a proper game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, following through on the shot as the description says. Go to the alley, start a game, and bowl a full game with a real follow-through on your throws. This is a moment trophy tied to that specific alley, so do it there and not at any other lane.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.tip: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. This is a vague, hidden-style trophy about your partnership's public standing, so it likely tracks a social or reputation milestone with your partner rather than a single action. Keep doing partner activities and watch for a reputation or follower-style milestone to pop; the exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description, so treat this as a play-naturally trophy and check back after major partner moments.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.tip: Play partner activities naturally; the trigger is a reputation milestone.

trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count to 500 for this trophy, which points at a long accumulation of decisions rather than one big choice: dialogue picks, activity choices and small moral calls across the game. There is no shortcut; just keep playing and choosing, and the count builds. If it has not popped by the end of the story, keep making choices in the open world.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Keep making choices; PSN tracks the count to 500.

trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try. The description points at a retry: fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on the very next attempt. It most likely tracks a second attempt at a challenge or activity, so if an attempt fails, go straight back in and complete it. Do not reload a save between the fail and the retry, or the chain may break.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.tip: Fail once, then succeed on the immediate retry without reloading.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description reads like a secret-encounter trophy: a weird event somewhere in Leonida, such as a UFO-style sighting or an unexplained moment in the world. Explore odd corners of the map at night, follow strange markers or sounds, and the event should trigger when you find the right spot. The exact location is not pinned down by the official description.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.tip: Explore strange spots, especially at night, until the event triggers.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl the target over. Get a car up to a moderate speed, pull alongside a pedestrian, and swing as you pass. Do it in a quiet area so the police do not turn a stunt into a chase.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.tip: Swing a melee weapon from a moving car as you pass a pedestrian.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who launders them and the clean money counts toward the $250,000 total. Keep laundering after every big score instead of sitting on dirty money, and PSN tracks the laundered total to $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Launder Marked Bills after every big score until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts: clothes, weapons, ammo, food, car mods and property upgrades. It accumulates over the whole playthrough, so a normal spending habit gets you most of the way there; for the remainder, buy expensive items you actually want, such as a high-end car or weapon upgrades, rather than wasting money on throwaways.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Spend normally all game; finish with big purchases you actually want.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings; each one gives you storage and counts toward the total of 8. Save up through the story, then buy them in a batch once money is comfortable. PSN tracks the property count to 8.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Buy all 8 garages once money is comfortable after the story.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on the in-game phone, add vehicles you own or find, and each registration counts toward 10. Register a mix of cars and bikes as you discover them so the list fills naturally; the app itself shows which vehicles are already registered.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count

trophies.tip: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app as you find them.
